name: I only needed a coffee
source:
You're at work and it's coffee time!

You have to try to keep a conversation with two of your coworkers. Don't be awkward!

[From [url=https://saialepi0u.itch.io/i-only-needed-a-coffee] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在工作，到了喝咖啡的時間！

你必須努力與兩名同事展開對話。別讓氣氛變尷尬！

（來源：[url=https://saialepi0u.itch.io/i-only-needed-a-coffee]itch.io[/url]）
